gpu_memory_notes: NLLB-200 model falls back to CPU when CUDA OOM (RTX 4050 6GB shared with Qwen3:4b via Ollama)
Embedding model (bge-m3) moved to CPU to preserve GPU memory for Qwen3
Translation on CPU adds ~500ms latency per query but ensures stability
Total GPU memory: 6GB, Qwen3:4b uses ~3.2GB, leaving insufficient for NLLB-200 on GPU
known_issues: Hindi/Marathi language detection conflation (shared Devanagari script) - detector sometimes returns 'hi' for Marathi queries
Qwen3 occasionally returns empty responses after cleaning (pre-existing Phase 5A issue) - affects ~20% of queries
Kannada query translation quality: 'ಪೆಟೆಂಟ್ ಎಂದಿಗ?' translates to 'Have you ever been patented?' instead of 'What is a patent?'
Malayalam query translation: 'പെട്ടന്റ് എന്താണ്?' translates to 'What's the matter?' instead of 'What is a patent?'
Gujarati and some other languages occasionally get 'low' confidence due to Qwen3 empty responses, not translation failure
First translation request has higher latency due to model loading (~5s)
next_step: Phase 6 - Production hardening: fix Qwen3 empty response issue, improve Hindi/Marathi disambiguation, optimize translation latency, add response caching
